messages:
Maya (CSM): Heads-up — Sierra Labs dedicated capacity go-live targeted for 2026-04-08 02:00 UTC. Need final sign-off on quota sizing, autoscale knobs, priming plan, and a fallback drill. They bought 12 reserved GPUs. Expect normal traffic ~70 QPS/model, occasional burst to ~480 QPS (multi-model) for ~10m. Who can confirm min/max GPUs and rollback criteria? @Sean @Priya @Liam @Jordan @Alex

Sean (Eng-Platform): Proposal: min=4 GPUs, max=14 GPUs, scale_step=1 GPU, scale_cooldown=120s. Autoscaler metric = tokens_sec_per_gpu with continuous batching. Recommend pre-warm 8 GPUs 12h prior and a 1h priming pass 2h before cutover.

Priya (Eng-SRE): SLOs: p95 latency <= 400ms, error-rate < 1%. Rollback triggers: sustained p95 > 600ms for 4m OR error-rate > 2% for 2m. I'll attach synthetic probes, health checks, and an on-call rota. Also we should whitelist test CIDRs.

Liam (DevEx): Load test plan (short): stage1 0->100 QPS (15m), stage2 100->300 QPS (20m), spike to 480 QPS (10m), drain 30m. We'll exercise both model variants (v1 float + v1-4bit). KV priming: run top-5k prefixes then a randomized replay of 30k recent keys.

Jordan (Solutions): Routing: route 65% to quantized variant during steady, 85% during bursts if p95 delta < 80ms. Need runtime flag to enforce cost-first routing with latency cap. Also request a controlled fallback drill where we kill one GPU during canary to validate automatic routing to healthy replicas.

Alex (Sierra): Confirm CI test IPs: 34.72.18.0/24 and 35.199.120.0/25. Canary window OK 01:30-03:00 UTC on 2026-04-08. We want a smoke dry-run 2026-04-07 22:30 UTC. We're fine with a single GPU termination during canary if you notify 20m ahead.

Sean (Eng-Platform): Runtime ok. Will add routing rule: prefer quantized when cost_saving > 30% and p95_diff < 80ms. Will post autoscaler JSON snippet here by EOD. We'll set draining timeout 45s and queue cutoff 8s.

Priya (Eng-SRE): Whitelisted IPs noted. I'll create the runbook page and include escalation steps, noise thresholds, and rollback checklist. Also adding a canary monitor that will auto-abort loadtests if error-rate crosses 1.5% for 60s.

Liam (DevEx): Vegeta snippet we'll use:
```
# vegeta attack
rate=320
duration=00m30s
targets=file://sierra_targets.txt
workers=60
output=report.bin
```
KV prime example:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/kv/prime -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"keys": ["prefix1","prefix2",...], "repeat": 3}'
```
Also we'll replay a small trace from prod with anonymized prompts.

Jordan (Solutions): I'll share the routing policy JSON tomorrow and the fallback test runbook. Suggest we schedule a 30m sync 2026-04-07 16:00 PT to confirm handoffs.

Alex (Sierra): All good. CI IPs confirmed, canary + smoke windows set. We'll provide a small pool of synthetic clients to coordinate the exact hit-timing.

deploy-bot: Dedicated pool allocated: pool_id=dp-ff34, reserved_gpus=12, created_by=maya.csm

Maya (CSM): Action items: Sean post autoscale config, Priya publish runbook + SLOs, Liam execute smoke Tue night, Jordan share routing JSON + fallback drill steps, Alex confirm final test client list. I'll run the 4/7 sync. Thanks :thumbsup:
